narrative.overview:
DailyDesk is a filing cabinet drawer on cool office paper. Status is a set of folder index tabs physically joined to the drawer below them; each task is one ruled line on a form inside that drawer. Text and the one primary action are written in navy ink. Everything else is paper, hairlines, and three tab hues that mean exactly one thing each: Todo, Doing, Done.

Density is a working list, not a dashboard. Rows are short (12px vertical padding), metadata sits in fixed columns on desktop and folds under the title on narrow screens, and deadline is the default order of everything. The system rejects card grids for tasks, hero metrics, gradients, and glass: depth comes from one soft drawer shadow and tonal paper steps.

The one moment of motion that matters is acknowledgement: a row that just changed stays washed in manila for a beat so the person notices it. The sign-in screen carries the same folder world in a warmer manila register.

The people at this desk are Vietnamese students and office workers between classes or meetings. The system is judged by how little they have to think: every action is a visible click or a key, nothing depends on dragging, hovering, or right-clicking, and every element on screen earns its place. A screen should never feel like an empty form, and never like a spreadsheet of every field the data model holds. The rule of thumb is the paper form itself: one line per task, the facts needed to decide what to do next, and everything else one click away inside the folder.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue-grey paper ground, white sheets, navy ink; color reserved for status and priority.
Folder index tabs with a 3px colored lip, joined to a bordered drawer.
Ruled task rows divided by hairlines, grouped under sticky deadline headers.
Be Vietnam Pro throughout; tabular figures for every date, time, and count.
Gentle 8px corners, hairline borders, one soft drawer shadow.
Click-first operation: status, deadline, and placement change through a visible control; drag is only an accelerator.
Fixed information budget per row and per card; secondary detail lives in the dialog, not on the line.

rules.name: The Three Tabs Rule
rules.body: Blue, amber, and green mean Todo, Doing, Done, and nothing else. A new feature may not borrow a status hue for decoration.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Each view has one filled navy button. Secondary actions are outline or ghost.

rules.name: The Square Means Priority Rule
rules.body: Priority is a 10px rounded square (3px radius); status is a round dot or pill. The shapes never swap.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, and count is set with tabular figures and the shared Vietnamese formats: "Hôm nay", "Ngày mai", "T4, 4/11", "T4, 4/11, 17:00", "Tháng 11, 2026". Do not hand-format dates in a component.

rules.name: The No Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 12px; the system has no uppercase tracked micro-labels.

rules.name: The Deadline First Rule
rules.body: Lists default to nearest deadline and group under sticky deadline headers; other sorts flatten the groups.

rules.name: The Earned Element Rule
rules.body: Every element answers "what do I do next?" or "is this mine and when is it due?". If removing it would not slow the person down, it does not ship on the line; move it into the dialog.

rules.name: The Not Empty, Not Crowded Rule
rules.body: The first viewport always holds the header, the filters, and real rows or a designed empty state; it never shows a lone form or a blank canvas. A row never exceeds the budget above, and a field that is unset shows a quiet placeholder ("—", "Không có hạn") rather than being dropped from a desktop column, so columns stay aligned.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: When the person has only one board, every board selector, filter, and board column is redundant and hides; the board name is still available inside the dialog.

rules.name: The One Drawer Rule
rules.body: One resting shadow per view, on the drawer. Everything else is flat until hovered or selected.

rules.name: The No Drag Required Rule
rules.body: Every change that dragging can make (status, list, order, date) has a visible click or keyboard path on the item or in its menu. Copy never tells the person to drag as the way to do something, and the default cursor on a working surface is never a grab hand.

rules.name: The Visible Action Rule
rules.body: No action lives only behind hover or right-click. Hover may reveal a shortcut button (the row "…" at `lg`) only when the same action is reachable by opening the item; context menus may duplicate a visible menu but never replace it.

rules.name: The One Status Rule
rules.body: A task has exactly one status, Todo / Doing / Done. A separate "done" checkbox that can disagree with the card's list is not allowed; ticking done means moving to Done.

dos: Do join status tabs to the drawer with the -1px overlap and a 3px status lip on the active tab.
Do use the shared date helpers and tabular figures for every date, time, and count.
Do keep one filled navy button per view and make everything else outline or ghost.
Do mark priority with the 10px square and status with dots or pills, colored only from the status and priority tokens.
Do flash a changed row in the manila wash so the change is noticed, and respect reduced motion for any added animation.
Do design every list state: skeleton rows, empty with a first action, filtered-empty with a reset, error with "Thử lại".
Do give every drag interaction a click path: a "Chuyển sang" menu for lists and status, menu commands for order, the "Hạn chót" field for dates.
Do keep a task row to status, title, one description line, and at most three metadata fields (board, priority, deadline).
Do hide a filter, column, or selector the moment it can only offer one real choice.
Do give every icon-only button an `aria-label` in Vietnamese and a 32px minimum target.
Do write all visible, toast, and screen-reader copy in Vietnamese with one spelling: "Xoá", "Huỷ", "task" (not "thẻ" or "card").
donts: Don't lay tasks out as a grid of cards, or add hero metrics, gradients, or glass panels.
Don't use a status hue (blue, amber, green) for anything that is not that status.
Don't add a second resting shadow beside the drawer, or heavier shadows than the drawer's.
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't pull the manila sign-in palette into the signed-in app; it is scoped to sign-in.
Don't make any action drag-only, hover-only, or right-click-only, and don't write copy such as "Kéo … để …" that presents dragging as the way to do something.
Don't put labels, members, checklist progress, comment or attachment counts, or progress bars on task rows or board cards.
Don't repeat the same count or the same shortcut hint twice in one view.
Don't let a task carry a "done" checkbox that can disagree with its Todo / Doing / Done status.
Don't ship a bare "Đang tải…" line, an error with no "Thử lại", or an empty state with no next action.

knownDrift.title: Lịch: the calendar is drag-only and mostly inert
knownDrift.detail: `src/pages/tasks.tsx` renders `EventCalendar` without `onEventSelect`, `onEventUpdate`, `onEventAdd`, or `onEventDelete`. In `src/components/event-calendar/event-calendar.tsx`, `handleEventSelect` returns early when no handler is given, so clicking a task opens nothing. Dragging shows a success toast but saves nothing, and "Thêm task" toasts without creating anything. The subtitle "Task có hạn chót của mọi board, xếp theo ngày. Kéo task sang ngày khác để đổi hạn." presents drag as the only way to change a deadline. Violates No Drag Required and Visible Action.

knownDrift.title: Board (Kanban): moving and reordering are drag-only
knownDrift.detail: Moving a card between lists, reordering cards, and reordering lists happen only through `handleDropOverColumn`, `handleDropOverListItem`, and `handleDropColumnOverColumn` in `src/pages/kanban/Kanban.tsx`. The card dialog's status control (`src/features/tasks/card-meta-controls.tsx`) reaches only lists named Todo / Doing / Done, so a custom list can only be reached by drag. The canvas uses `cursor-grab` drag-to-pan. Violates No Drag Required.

knownDrift.title: Board card: actions are right-click only
knownDrift.detail: `src/pages/kanban/KanbanCard.tsx` puts "Sửa" and "Gỡ" in a `ContextMenu` with no visible "…" button. "Gỡ" and the confirm copy "Xóa thẻ" / "Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa thẻ này?" break the "Xoá task" vocabulary, and there is no "Hoàn tác" toast. Violates Visible Action and the copy rule.

knownDrift.title: Board card: a second, conflicting status
knownDrift.detail: The round "Đánh dấu xong" checkbox in `KanbanCard.tsx` toggles `completed`/`dueComplete` without moving the card to Done, so a ticked card can sit in Todo. It is a `div role="checkbox" tabIndex={-1}`, so the keyboard cannot reach it. It is drawn in raw `bg-green-500` / `!text-green-600` instead of the Done token. Violates One Status and Three Tabs.

knownDrift.title: Board card and header: off-system color and material
knownDrift.detail: The "Mẫu" badge uses `bg-blue-500` / `bg-blue-100 text-blue-700`, borrowing Todo blue. Cover images use a `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80` scrim (`KanbanCard.tsx`). The board header bar is glass (`bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm`) with an off-palette `bg-cyan-400` progress bar and the English tooltip "Board Progress: N%" (`src/pages/kanban/BoardHeaderBar.tsx`). "Thêm danh sách" is a `bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md` glass button (`src/pages/kanban/AddListForm.tsx`). The floating Kanban/Lịch switcher is glass with `shadow-lg`, a second resting shadow (`Kanban.tsx`). The board color floods the whole canvas.

knownDrift.title: Board columns: clutter where it does not help, nothing where it would
knownDrift.detail: `src/pages/kanban/ColumnHeader.tsx` shows edit and delete icon buttons on every column at all times, without `aria-label`s, while the column's task count is commented out. Every column footer pairs "Thêm task" with an extra template icon button (`src/pages/kanban/AddCardForm.tsx`).

knownDrift.title: English copy in a Vietnamese UI
knownDrift.detail: Drag-and-drop screen-reader text in `src/components/kanban.tsx` ("To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar." and the `defaultAnnouncements`). Calendar toasts in `event-calendar.tsx` (`Event "…" updated/added/deleted`, `Card "…" from list "Unknown list" moved to …`). Event dialog strings in `src/components/event-calendar/event-dialog.tsx` ("Pick a start date or due date", "Due date cannot be before start date", "Edit the details of this card", "Add a new card to your calendar"). `createLabel="New card"` in `Kanban.tsx`. "Attach" and "Link name (optional)" in `src/components/card-edit-dialog/card-edit-dialog.tsx`. `AllBoardsDialog` titles "All My Boards (n)" / "All Invited Boards (n)" and raw role badges ("admin", "member") in `src/Home.tsx`.

knownDrift.title: Lịch: states not designed; status hues reused
knownDrift.detail: `src/pages/tasks.tsx` shows a bare "Đang tải task…" line, an error ("Không tải được task") with no "Thử lại", and an empty state ("Chưa có task nào có hạn chót") with no action. Events are colored `sky` / `amber` / `rose` / `emerald` by due state, so amber "sắp đến hạn" reads as Doing and the hues are raw Tailwind, not tokens.

knownDrift.title: Card dialog: secondary features before the core decision
knownDrift.detail: In `card-edit-dialog.tsx` the "Nhãn", "Ngày", "Đính kèm", and "Lưu làm mẫu" button row sits above "Trạng thái" / "Độ ưu tiên". The active "Mẫu" toggle becomes a second filled navy button. The cover and close icon buttons have no `aria-label`. The dialog is fixed at 1200 × 600px with a 500px minimum main column, which crowds small laptops and overflows phones.

knownDrift.title: Board list: the create action is not a button
knownDrift.detail: In `src/Home.tsx`, "Tạo board mới" is a clickable dashed `Card` div that the keyboard cannot reach, and the view has no navy primary action. "Mở gần đây" repeats boards already shown in "Board của tôi". A search that matches no owned board shows no "no match" message (only the invited section has one).

knownDrift.title: Việc của tôi: hand-formatted date
knownDrift.detail: The header date in `src/features/tasks/tasks-page.tsx` uses date-fns `"EEEE d/M"` ("Thứ Hai 2/11") instead of the shared helpers in `src/lib/date.ts`. Violates The Tabular Clock Rule.

knownDrift.title: Việc của tôi: redundant board column
knownDrift.detail: `TaskRow` and the column header in `tasks-page.tsx` always show the board, even when there is one board and the Board pill is already hidden. Violates The One Board Rule.

knownDrift.detail: The footer line "Hiển thị x/y task · Bấm vào một dòng để sửa · Phím tắt: N thêm task, / tìm kiếm" repeats the shortcut hints already shown as `kbd` on the "Thêm task" button and in the search field (`tasks-page.tsx`).
